description: Search managed-database (RDS-class) pricing across clouds, ranked by USD/hour (also monthly = ×730). For the instance-based, cross-cloud-comparable categories: relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL), later cloud-native/cache/document. Filter by engine, min/max vCPU & memory, deployment (single/multi_az), provider, region/country/continent/near, charge_type. Answers 'cheapest managed MySQL with ≥4 vCPU / 16 GiB in Singapore'. Use list_db_categories first to pick the right category. Set storage_gib to add storage to the monthly total. Coverage: AWS (RDS/Aurora and more engines), Azure, GCP, AlibabaCloud, TencentCloud, HuaweiCloud/HuaweiCloudIntl.

category.description: db category id (default relational); see list_db_categories

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

deployment.description: single or multi_az (HA); omit for any

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

storage_gib.description: if set, add this much DB storage to the monthly total (instance + storage)

storage_type.description: storage type for storage_gib: gp3 (default), io1, io2, magnetic, aurora

name: search_databases
title: Search managed databases
